resources.title: What is HTTP? Protocol Overview for Beginners
resources.why: Start here: a friendly walk through what a request looks like, with the method, path, version, headers and body explained one by one.

resources.title: Overview of HTTP
resources.why: The big picture of how a client and a server talk, so you know where the raw request you parse comes from.

resources.title: HTTP messages
resources.why: Shows the exact layout of a request line, headers, the blank line and the body: the same structure your parser splits apart.

resources.title: HTTP request methods
resources.why: A reference list of GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE and friends, including which ones are safe, for your is_safe_method function.

resources.title: urllib.parse: Parse URLs into components
resources.why: The official reference for urlsplit and parse_qsl, the two functions you use to separate the path from the query string.
